e.body:
**Credify Insurance Widget**（npm `@getcredify/credify-insurance-widget`）**是一个**可以**用**三**种**方式**嵌**入**的**保险**报价**控**件****——**逐字自述**为**「**A React-based insurance quote widget that can be installed via npm package or embedded via script tag or iframe.**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**新面 **PubMed（**健康**保险**线）＋**收**掉**上轮**留**下**的**候选」**。
**可核实信息（均 2026-09-27 npm registry 实测）**：
**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它**给**出**三**种**嵌**入**方式**，**并**把**集**成**约**束**写**在 **README** 前**段****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README** 逐字**写**「**A React-based insurance quote widget that can be installed via npm package or embedded via script tag or iframe.**」**，**并**逐字**说明**「**This package requires React 18+ or React 19+ as a peer dependency: The library build externalizes all React entry points (`react`, `react-dom`, `react-dom/client`, `react/jsx-runtime`) (`react`, `react-dom`, `react-dom/client`, `react/jsx-runtime`), so the host must provide a single React/React-DOM (18.x or 19.x).**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**对 **RIAA** 最有用**：**⭐ 即**把**报价**流程**嵌**进**别**人**的**网站**时**，**第**一**道**坎**不**是**接**口**而是**「**宿**主**页**面**里**只**能**有**一**份 **React」**——**⭐ 因**为**两**份 **React** 会**让 **hooks**/**context** 各**自**一**套**，**表**现**为**难**以**定**位**的**运**行**时**错**误**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**读**嵌**入**式**产品**的**文档**时**，**先**看 **peer dependency** 与**外**部**化**声明**，**再**看**功能**列表**（**⭐ 与**第 **382** 轮**记下的**「**先**看**集**成**约束**再**看**功能」**同**向）**。
**⭐⭐ ② ⚠️⭐ 它**反**证**了**第 **382** 轮**的**一**条**可**迁移**判**据**（**「**从**包**反**查**托**管**平台」**有**前**提）****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**该**包**的**元数据**中 **`repository`** 与 **`homepage`** 两**个**字**段**都**不**存在**（**本词条**按**「**字段**缺**失」**记**录，**而**不**记**为**空**字符串）**；**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**第 **382** 轮**那**条**判**据**（**从 **npm** 包**的 **`repository`／**`homepage` 反**查**代**码**托管**平台）**只**对**公开**仓库**的**包**有**效**，**闭**源**商**业**包**会**让**这**条**路**中**断**——**⭐ 故**该**判据**要**补**上**前**提**：**⭐ 「**先**确认**这**两**个**字**段**是**否**存在」**（**⭐ 与**第 **381** 轮**「**接口**许可**字段**空 **≠ **无**许可」**同**属**「**先**分清**「**字段**缺失」**与**「**字段**为空」）**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**把**检**索**技**巧**当**成**「**有**条件**成立」**的**经验**，**而**不**是**通**用**法**则**。
**⭐⭐ ③ 它**的**依**赖**清**单**可**以**当**成**一**份**技**术**选**型**样**本****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**元数据**逐字**给出 **`dependencies`** 为 **`zod ^4.3.6`／**`@sentry/react ^8.40.0`／**`react-aria-components ^1.19.0`／**`@internationalized/date ^3.12.2`／**`@getcredify/credify-insurance-ui-kit ^1.5.0`****，**`peerDependencies`** 逐字**为 **`react ^18.0.0 || ^19.0.0`** 与 **`react-dom ^18.0.0 || ^19.0.0`****；**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**一**个**嵌**入**式**表**单**类**产品**的**最**小**依赖**集**往**往**是**这**五**类**——**结**构**校**验**（**zod）**、**前**端**错**误**监**控**（**Sentry）**、**无**障**碍**组**件**（**react-aria）**、**国**际**化**日期**与**自家 **UI** 套件**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**做**产品**选型**或**技**术**评**估**时**，**读**一**个**成**熟**包**的**依**赖**清**单**，**比**看**其**功能**宣**传**更**能**判**断**它**真**正**依**赖**什么**。
**⭐⭐ ④ 它**是**闭**源**商**业**包**，**但**有**实**际**调**用**信**号****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**首次**发布 **2025-11-02****、**末次**修改 **2026-09-24T11:20:13Z****（**窗口内）**、**共 **73** 个**版本****、**维护**者 **3** 人**（**逐字 **`nimin.ms`／**`samc621`／**`thewildzeno`）**、**周**下载量**逐字 **689**（**区**间 **`2026-09-18` 至 **`2026-09-24`）**、**许可**逐字 **`ISC`****；**⭐ 本词条**如实**指出**：**⭐ 即**「**被**嵌**入**在**别**人**网站**上**跑」**这**类**产**品**，**其**存**活**与**迭**代**节**奏**可**以**从 **npm** 元**数据**读**出**（**版**本**数**与**最近**发布**时**间）**；**⭐ 而**下**载**量 **689** 说**明**有**实**际**调**用**但**规**模**有**限**（**⭐ 与**第 **382** 轮**记下的**「**下**载**量**只**证明**没**被**废**弃」**一**致）**。
**⭐⭐ ⑤ 元数据**与**窗口****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**末次**修改 **2026-09-24****（**窗口内）**、**描述**逐字**为 **`Credify Insurance Widget - Embeddable React widget for insurance quotes`****、**README** 实测 **23,131** 字符**；**⭐ 本词条**如实**指出**：**⭐ 即**它**进入**本轮**视**野**的**原因**是**最近**发布**时间**在**窗口内**（**⭐ 与**第 **382** 轮**「**最近**发布 **≠ **新**作品」**同**类，**而**本**条**首**次**发布 **2025-11-02）**。
**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[embedded-pet-insurance-sdk]] 覆盖**嵌入**式**宠物**保险 **SDK**、**[[clarity-sdk]] 与 **[[emilgroup-insurance-sdk]] 覆盖**保险**领域**的**客户端 **SDK****——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**以 **React** 组**件**形**式**嵌**入**报价**流程**、**并**以 **peer dependency** 约**束**宿**主**环境」这一**形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。
**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **嵌**入**式**产品**先**看 **peer dependency**；**② **检**索**技**巧**要**记**前**提**（**字段**是否**存在）**；**③ **依**赖**清**单**是**选型**信**息**源**；**④ **版**本**数**与**最近**发布**可**判**迭**代**节**奏**；**⑤ **下**载**量**只**证明**没**被**废**弃**。
**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有安装**该 **npm** 包**、**未**在**任何**页面**中**渲染**其**组件**、**未**调**用**其**报价**流程**，**故**不**主张**其**功能**可用**性**、**渲染**正确性**或**报价**结果**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**npm registry** 的**包**元数据**（**含 **`versions`／**`time`／**`license`／**`maintainers`／**`dependencies`／**`peerDependencies`** 与 **README** 前**段）**与**下载**量**接口**，**未读**其**源**码**（**⭐ 该**包**无 **`repository`** 字段**，**亦**无**公开**源码**可**读）**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**三**种**嵌**入**方式**是否**都**当**前**可用**（**README** 自述**，**本**词条**未**试）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**是**否**需**要**客**户**密**钥**或**后**端**配**置**才**能**取**报价**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**支**持**的**国**家**与**险**种**范围**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核实**其**依**赖**库**的**许可**是**否**与 **ISC** 兼**容**（**⭐ 本**词条**只**记**录**依赖**清单）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 窗口**状况**：**末次**修改 **2026-09-24** 落在**本轮**窗口**之内**（**基准日 **2026-09-27）**，**故**无需**缺口**说明**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-27 所见**；**⚠️ 涉**及**嵌**入**式**报价**与**前端**集成**，**⚠️ 不**构成**任何**技术**选型**或**商业**建议**。

e.title_en: An insurance quote widget that can be embedded in three ways: it describes itself as a React-based widget installable as a package or embeddable through a script tag or an iframe, it declares React as a peer dependency with two supported major versions and states in writing that the library build externalises all React entry points so the host must provide a single copy of the framework, and its registry metadata contains neither a repository nor a homepage field, which means the technique of working back from a package to its source repository does not apply to a closed-source package.
e.title_hk: **一個**可**以**用**三**種**方**式**嵌**入**的**保**險**報**價**控**件****：`credify-insurance-widget`——**⭐ 逐字自述**「**A React-based insurance quote widget that can be installed via npm package or embedded via script tag or iframe.**」**；**⭐ 它把 React 列為 peer dependency**（**逐字 `react ^18.0.0 || ^19.0.0`）**，**並逐字說明**「**The library build externalizes all React entry points (`react`, `react-dom`, `react-dom/client`, `react/jsx-runtime`), so the host must provide a single React/React-DOM**」**——**⭐ 即**宿主頁面不能有兩份 React**；**⚠️⭐ 而它的 npm 元資料裡 `repository` 與 `homepage` 兩個字段都不存在**——**⭐ 即**第 382 輪記下的「**從包反查倉庫」**這條路在閉源包上走不通**
e.summary_en: This is an insurance quote widget that can be embedded in three ways, describing itself as a React-based widget installable as a package or embeddable through a script tag or an iframe. **Measured this round**: the latest version is a build published under a permissive licence, first released in late 2025 and last modified on the twenty-fourth of September inside the window, with seventy-three versions, three maintainers, and a few hundred weekly downloads in the week before this round, and a readme of about twenty-three thousand characters. **This round theme is a new surface in a health insurance line together with collecting candidates deferred from the previous round.** **Four things are worth reading: it gives three embedding modes and one real integration constraint, stating that the package can be installed as a package or embedded via a script tag or an iframe, and explaining that the library build externalises all React entry points so the host must provide a single copy of the framework at one of two supported major versions, which matters because embedding a quotation flow into someone else page looks like an interface problem while the first obstacle is that only one copy of the framework may exist in the host page or hooks and context break, so reading an embedded product documentation should start from peer dependencies and externalisation statements rather than features; **Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-27 from the package registry**:
**First, it gives three embedding modes and puts the integration constraint in the opening of the readme.** The readme describes a React-based insurance quote widget installable as a package or embeddable via a script tag or an iframe, and explains that the package requires one of two framework major versions as a peer dependency and that the library build externalises all React entry points so the host must provide a single copy of the framework. **Embedding a quotation flow into someone else page looks like an interface problem, while the first obstacle is that only one copy of the framework may exist in the host page, because two copies give hooks and context separate stores and produce runtime errors that are hard to localise, so reading an embedded product documentation should start from peer dependencies and externalisation statements rather than features.**
**Second, it contradicts a criterion recorded in the previous round, which therefore needs a precondition.** The package metadata contains neither a repository nor a homepage field, and this entry records that as the fields being absent rather than empty. **The technique of working back from a registry package to its hosting platform therefore only works for packages with public repositories, since a closed-source commercial package breaks the chain, so the criterion should begin by confirming that the fields exist at all, in the same family as the earlier rule that an empty licence field does not mean an absent licence, where the first question is whether the field exists. Search techniques should be treated as conditional experience rather than general rules.**
**Third, its dependency list works as a technology selection sample.** The metadata lists a schema validation library, an error monitoring client, accessible component primitives, an internationalised date library, and the vendor own UI kit, with the framework itself declared as peer dependencies across two major versions. **The minimum dependency set of an embedded form product tends to be those five kinds, so reading the dependency list of a mature package reveals what it really depends on more reliably than its feature copy.**
**Fourth, it is a closed-source commercial package with a real traffic signal.** It was first published in late 2025 and last modified on the twenty-fourth of September inside the window, with seventy-three versions, three maintainers, a few hundred weekly downloads in the week before this round, and a permissive licence. **Products of the embedded kind leave a survival and iteration signal in registry metadata through version counts and last publish dates, while a few hundred downloads indicates real but limited usage, consistent with the earlier note that a download count only proves a package has not been abandoned.**
**Fifth, metadata and window status.** The description reads as an embeddable React widget for insurance quotes and the readme runs to about twenty-three thousand characters. **It entered view because its last publish falls inside the window, the same class as the earlier distinction between a recent publish and a new artefact, since its first release was in late 2025.**
**Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover an embedded pet insurance SDK and other insurance client SDKs, **while this entry supplies the form of a quotation flow embedded as a React component with the host environment constrained through peer dependencies. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**
**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: check peer dependencies first for an embedded product; record the preconditions of any search technique; read dependency lists as selection evidence; use version counts and last publish dates to read iteration cadence; and remember downloads prove only that a package is not abandoned.**
